### `stratum`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stratum.backward-compatible` | `Boolean` | `false` | Whether external contracts stay as they were. |

## Web

Module page: [Web → Properties](../modules/web.md#properties).

### `stratum.web`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stratum.web.enabled` | `Boolean` | `true` | Whether the web module is on. |

### `stratum.web.request-log`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stratum.web.request-log.max-length` | `Integer` | `512` | The longest line, from 1 to 10000. Café "quoted" tab here. |
| `stratum.web.request-log.skip-paths` | `List<String>` | `/actuator/**, /health` | Paths with no line, such as /actuator/\*\* or /internal/\*, and client\_id \| x \< y \[z\] \\ \`t\`. |

### `stratum.web.request-log.headers`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stratum.web.request-log.headers.names` | `Map<String, HeaderSettings>` | *(empty)* | The headers, by the name in its `@StratumClient` or `Foo#bar()`. |
